## Description

Forward-only migration setting every existing tenant to Approved with an audit entry naming the migration, and marking existing doctor licences attested by the tenant's owner as of migration time (the owner re-confirms on next sign-in). Regenerate the ERD in the same change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an existing tenant, when the migration runs, then it is Approved and keeps working with no new step.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a doctor licence that was Verified, Pending or Rejected, when the migration runs, then it shows owner-attested and the audit names the migration.
- [ ] **AC3.** Tested against a real database seeded with each prior licence state; docs/03-architecture/erd.md is regenerated.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
